scope: Actual model (Blender/The_Commons_Compact.blend, unchanged since v0.9.0) with the v0.10.0 experience geometry rebuilt from Unity/Assets/TheCommons/Data/experience_layout.json at CommonsExperienceBuilder's dimensions (Blender/render_experience_views.py). Ride cars use the baked ride poses. Lighting is the WARM palette. Not Unity/VRChat runtime captures: Unity draws the new objects with toon/holo shaders, light probes and its own post effects. The view-jack image ports the shader math to numpy (Blender/render_viewjack_preview.py) as a design check.
